component: Connection and certificate alert callback lifetime

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In the inspected alert hook, activeAlerts tracks duplicate suppression only. The certificate error context stays in the showExceptionDialog closure and the notification click calls that function directly. Resolving the five-second debounce removes the cookie from the Set; it does not look up or delete the captured certificate context. This keeps the dialog input separate from duplicate-alert state. It does not prove a native backend delivers a later click or that an override is safe or automatic. The owned observer API and later accepted callback API are separate phases. No native notification or certificate UI ran.
title: Certificate alert callbacks keep their context after debounce expiry
